content:
As AirPods Pro 3 continue to drop 25% and AirPods Max 2 see $100 discounts, we're gearing up for the weekend. Today's top story in the 9to5Toys Lunch Break is the lowest-price 13-inch M5 MacBook Air available through the official Apple Refurbished Store for $1,099, available in three colors (a $200 discount)—act fast, as this model typically sells out quickly. We also have MacBook Neo discounts of up to $120, Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop on Amazon for nearly $100 off, and the latest 240W Beats Woven USB-C cable down to $18 with Prime free shipping at an Amazon low (40% off). Don't forget to check out the updated 2026 Best Buy Back to School deals—see below for more details.

Summer AirPods deals continue: Max 2 down $100, AirPods Pro 3 down 25%, more starting from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation $149 (originally $179)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation $119 (originally a brand-new $179)—Renewed Premium

Best Buy updates 2026 Back to School deals: TVs under $500, Bose down $130, Apple products, Ninja kitchen appliances, and more

The lowest-price 13-inch M5 MacBook Air returns to the official Apple Refurbished Store at $1,099, available in 3 colors (a $200 discount)

The official Apple Refurbished Store has always been a great place to save money, especially now that the MacBook lineup has seen price increases. The base configurations of the Pro lineup and M5 MacBook Air series tend to come and go quickly—this morning we spotted the lowest-priced 13-inch M5 MacBook Air in all three colors, marked down to $1,099—$200 below the regular price.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is currently selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for $1,099 with free shipping. At the time of writing, this deal is still live and applies to the Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue models.

These products come with:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligible for AppleCare purchase
  • Apple's rigorous refurbishment certification

What you're looking at is the lowest configuration of the M5 MacBook Air, which retails for $1,299 new. Today's Apple Refurbished Store deal takes $200 off the original price—the best offer we've found on this entry-level current-generation model.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

This is the Apple Refurbished Store, arguably the highest quality refurbished MacBook Air you can buy—but how does it compare to current retail new prices?

Amazon is currently selling this configuration at near-retail price, with only the Silver model slightly lower at $1,240. Although this machine has sold for less in the past, since the price increase, we haven't seen Amazon's new unit price drop below $1,149, and that deal was fleeting about a month ago.

Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop now down nearly $100 on Amazon

If I do say so myself, these two smartwatch combos currently discounted nearly $100 on Amazon are two of the best-looking in the world—the Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with the Milanese Loop, available in Natural Titanium or Black.

Although the $100 discount on the cheaper Ocean Band configuration has ended, Amazon is now selling the Natural or Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop for $799.99 with free shipping.

These two configurations carry a price tag of up to $899 because of that gorgeous woven steel Milanese Loop, but they're now nearly $100 off on Amazon:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (originally $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (originally $899)

Apple is expected to launch a new generation of Ultra wearables next month, but the RAMageddon has already spread across the iPad and MacBook lineups, and it looks like the new Apple Watch models could be the next victims. The existing product line hasn't been affected for now, but they're still mini computers on your wrist, and the Ultra 4/Series 12 might be the next to take the hit.

Of course, we wouldn't blame anyone for wanting to wait and see what else Apple has up its sleeve in September, but in less than a month, these things could be priced higher than ever before.

The Series models may face a similar situation, and they're currently getting the same $100 discount on Amazon:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

Grab the latest 240W Beats Woven USB-C cable, down to $18 with Prime free shipping at an Amazon new low (40% off)

While the 240W black model is still at its $18 Prime free shipping historic low, grab a few of these 10-foot Beats woven USB-C cables.

Amazon is now dropping the latest 10-foot Beats 240W USB-C woven cable to $18.03, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

These 2026 new models feature higher power transmission specs and retail for $30—to be honest, that's a bit steep even for a high-end 10-foot USB-C cable. But at a 40% discount off retail, I think everyone should have a few of these higher-end, better-looking models in their EDC or home collection.

The lowest price right now is the Bolt Black model, but you can also find Navy at $19, Surge Stone at $20.85 after clipping the on-page coupon, and the red model at around $24.

As mentioned above, this is the latest model, upgraded from the older 60W to 240W high-power transmission, with an extra-long 10-foot cable, and the same tangle-resistant woven design—'More durable, more convenient. Elevate your charging experience and say goodbye to tangles, kinks, and wear with our reinforced woven cable.'

Amazon restocks 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 cellular version at $100 off, deals starting from $299

Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand returns to Prime Day historic low (35% off)

I had the chance to try out this model when it launched earlier this year, and Anker's 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger has become a must-have for my EDC, travel, and home charging setup. Now available at nearly 35% off, we have another chance to grab it at Amazon's lowest price.

The official Anker Amazon store is now selling their latest 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger for $99.97 with free shipping.

This charger retails for $150, features a 3-in-1 design with a MagSafe charging pad outputting up to 25W, and is now available at nearly 35% off retail, in both Phantom Gray/Black and Radiant White.

This week's deals match those mentioned previously, aligning with Anker's big summer sale and this year's Prime Day prices.

Although it's palm-sized and portable, it does have some weight to it, making it stable enough for your desk or nightstand—equally convenient whether you're using it at a home workstation or on the go.

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Belkin's brand-new compact 100W USB-C MacBook GaN charger with 5-foot cable drops to just $25
  • Power your entire desk setup with this SABRENT 252W 8-port charging station for just $60 (historic low)
  • Baseus 20,000mAh 100W laptop power bank with dual built-in cables for just $33 (58% off)
  • Acer woven USB/Thunderbolt 4 Type-C cable supporting 240W charging, 8K, and more for just $16
  • Anker 140W 4-port MacBook charger with smart display today only $56
  • Launch deal: brand-new Schlage Home Key Sense Pro smart lock with Ultra Wideband auto-unlock
  • KeySmart transparent 'Ghost' SmartCard Find My wallet locator returns to Amazon low
  • Spigen mini MagSafe iPhone backpack/EDC pouch now just $27
  • Anker 5-port Nano travel adapter keeps you powered in 'over 200 countries' for just $20

Official Apple Refurbished Store MacBook Neo hits lowest price, up to $120 below retail

In addition to the MacBook Air and M5-series MacBook Pro, Apple's more affordable new MacBook Neo also saw a price increase earlier, but you can sidestep the hike through the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store—the MacBook Neo starts at $689 on Amazon, but you can get it from Apple's best refurbished store starting at $599, with full Apple warranty.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store offers all MacBook Neo configurations at the lowest prices we've found from reputable sources, with the same official Apple warranty and Apple's 'rigorous' refurbishment certification.

  • Apple refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (originally $699 new)
  • Apple refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (originally $799 new)

Although you won't see any special offers when you open the Apple Refurbished Store product page, they're still at least $100 below the new MSRP—the 512GB model with Touch ID keyboard is actually $120 below the new price, and $20 below the previous price.

Yes, they're refurbished, and yes, they've just adjusted the prices back—or close—to the old MSRP, but these are the lowest prices for the most affordable current-generation MacBook.

For some, saving $100 to $120 might not be worth opting for a refurbished unit—that's perfectly understandable, but this isn't exactly a small amount, and we're talking about the highest-quality refurbished products straight from Apple.
